name: orcstack
description: Personal engineering workflow plugin for Claude Code, Codex, oh-my-pi, and opencode. Port of Poteto Stack (pstack) by Lauren Tan.

scripts.tier0: npm run validate && npm run check-no-sdd && npm run input-gate
scripts.input-gate: node src/skills/work-brief/scripts/brief.mjs check && node src/skills/adr/scripts/adr.mjs check
scripts.check: npm run tier0 && npm run test
scripts.e2e:model: node tests/e2e/routing.mjs; r=$?; node tests/e2e/gate.mjs || r=1; node tests/e2e/extensions.mjs --case extend || r=1; node tests/e2e/extensions.mjs --case off || r=1; exit $r
